sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Added a "Date info" family ("- Complete", "- Partial", "- Range") to the unique-values (📊) dropdown, applying automatically to every column fed into a `dateParts` extractor on every pageType (e.g. "Date", "Begin", "End", "Release date" — no per-pageType feature flag needed). Each row's own displayed date expression is classified by the new `_findCellDateExpressionParts()` into a full "YYYY-MM-DD" date ("- Complete"), a year-only "YYYY" or year-month "YYYY-MM" date ("- Partial"), or two dates joined by a dash ("- Range") — a range's own two sides are never assumed to both be complete, so e.g. "1973-08-09 – 1973-09-23" is handled without assuming both ends are full dates. Checking an entry narrows the table and highlights the matching cell's own date text.
